caption: The video captures a close-up macro view of a triangular, trilliant-cut opal cabochon pinched between fingertips above and below, against a dark background tinted deep red by the skin. The stone's pale body glows with a shifting play-of-color, where broad patches of vivid green, orange, yellow and red expand and contract, with brief blue-violet tones surfacing. A small white specular highlight slides across the domed surface as the gem tilts and wobbles subtly within the grip, reorienting the color bands. The four holding fingers stay in fixed screen positions, so the visible motion is the stone's slight rotation, not a traveling hand. No camera pan or zoom is evident, keeping the framing constant. This continuous flashing of color persists across the excerpt, neither starting nor settling within the shown span.
relations: Pinched fingertips hold the triangular opal, so its slight tilt reorients visible color patches.
Changing viewing angle makes green, orange, yellow, and red flashes expand, contract, and shift.
A white specular highlight slides across the domed surface as the stone wobbles.
Fingers remain fixed in frame, so motion appears as gem rotation, not hand travel.
